items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: So Albert and Barney, they got together and they made an arrangement that they would take and teach one another about the instrument.

ctx.x: No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.

No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. often in Chicago. I lived up there and every time Louis Armstrong come to town with Natty Dominick, I knew very well. We'd go up to see Barney at the theater and he told us a little bit about T.O. too, how he studied with T.O. and I noticed that Barney uses both lips on the cupboard over his teeth and not very many people here do that anymore. Do you know that the T.O.s ever teach him that? I forget. I don't know if he told me if T.O. taught him. Well, I'll tell…
Well, the brass bands do what you're talking about. They play 2-4 until the out chorus. Now, you hear them do that.
